en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a wooden railway station building with a tiled gable roof. A sign on the facade reads "LANDVETTER". Three people sit on a bench on the platform in front of the building. Bicycles and a small kiosk appear to the left, and railway tracks run in the foreground. Text at the bottom identifies the scene as the Landvetter railway station, and a small publisher's mark with a number appears in the lower right.
